name: playful-american-girl-cafe
image_purpose: casual outfit, drink, and cafe environment reference

prompt.project_info: Create an outdoor cafe lifestyle portrait of an approved adult woman on a sunny day.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long loose light-brown or dark-blonde waves, wearing a white fitted tank, bright pink sweatpants, white high-top sneakers, and a backward white cap; she holds an iced red drink with a green straw and gives a playful wink.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level three-quarter-body candid from a seated position, no selfie arm or phone visible, black metal chair, outdoor cafe table, sunglasses, glass reflections, urban European street, and blurred cafe patrons. Supplied beverage/retail marks may remain only as reference details; do not invent logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural midday sunlight with warm glow, realistic outdoor shadows and reflections.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone-style candid photography, portrait 9:16, natural skin and fabric detail, slight low angle, realistic reflections.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long loose light-brown waves sits at a sunny outdoor cafe table wearing a white tank, bright pink sweatpants, white high-top sneakers, and a backward white cap. She holds an iced red drink with a green straw and gives a playful wink. Include glass reflections, urban street, cafe furniture, and natural midday light. Preserve supplied brand marks only when intentionally required; do not invent logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, transparent clothing, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, warped drink, fake logo, invented brand text, watermark, public figure likeness.
